Professor — about next week's CSE455 staff meeting: I've started looking at your calendar, but there's no staff meeting on it yet, so I need your input.

Could you tell me: preferred day and time, how long, and who should come (all TAs, or a subset)? If you have a regular slot in mind from previous quarters, say so and I'll aim for that.

Looking at your week, the gaps I can see: Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30, Thursday 13:40-14:40 is taken... Thursday has no clean slot before 15:30, and Friday is full from 09:00 to 17:00 except 12:30 lunch. Wednesday 16:00-17:00 is a PhD 1:1. So the realistic candidates are Tuesday 15:00-15:30 or Wednesday 13:00-13:30, if a half hour suffices.

Also: is there anything official I should check with the department office — room booking, or whether a required attendee is away?

On it — I've asked the TA group thread for their availability next week (the clean half-hour gaps: Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 13:00-13:30), and I'll come back to you with the slot they agree on so you can approve it before I book.

If you already know how long it should be or who must attend, tell me now and I'll fold it in — otherwise I'll assume all five TAs and 30 minutes.

Thirty minutes with all five TAs is right, and I'd rather it be Tuesday or Wednesday if that works for them — I want Monday left alone with the colloquium and faculty meeting crowding it. Please get a room booked through the department office before you book the slot, and let me know what they say.

Hello — Hana, TA for CSE455. Could you send me the official schedule for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27): lectures, seminars and university meetings? I'm helping arrange a CSE455 staff meeting and want to avoid clashing with anything on the university side. Thank you.

Hello — this is alvarez-agent, assistant to Professor Alvarez (CSE455). He'd like a room for the CSE455 staff meeting next week, 30 minutes, all five TAs attending.

Two candidate slots: **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30** and **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30**. Please let me know: (1) whether a room is free in either slot and which one you'd recommend, (2) the room name, and (3) whether any of the attendees would be away, and whether the Thursday/Friday are affected by the holiday break.

Thanks — I'll confirm the final slot with the Professor once I hear from you.

Understood: 30 minutes, all five TAs, Tuesday or Wednesday — Monday left alone.

So far all four TAs who've replied (John, Priya, Diego, Hana) are free in both Tuesday 15:00-15:30 and Wednesday 13:00-13:30. I've written to the department office about a room in those two slots and asked whether anyone would be away; still waiting on Sarah's availability. I'll report back with the room before booking.
Good. Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is my first choice if the room comes through; Wednesday is fine as a fallback. Ping me when Sarah replies and the office has answered.

Hello. I can give you what's on the official schedule, but not room bookings or people's private time.

(1) Neither slot clashes with anything on the official university-side schedule for next week:
- Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30 — free; the nearest items are CSE452 lecture 14:00–15:00 and, from 15:30, CSE455 office hours (15:30–16:20) and Seminar (15:30–17:00).
- Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 — free; the nearest items are CSE444 lecture 12:20–13:00 and, from 13:30, CSE452 lecture and CSE455 quiz section (13:30–14:20), Guest lecture prep (13:30–14:30).
So I can't recommend one over the other on schedule grounds.

(2) I can't help with the room: I have no room-booking information and I don't arrange or move other people's meetings. Room allocation isn't mine to confirm.

(3) I don't know anyone's private appointments, so I can't say whether the attendees would be away. On the holiday break: I have no notice of one, and nothing on the official schedule for Thu 26 or Fri 27 Nov is cancelled or moved — both days are full as published.

I'll pass on anything further once it's confirmed with the Professor.

Thank you — noted: both slots are clear on the official schedule, no holiday break notice for Thu 26 / Fri 27, and room allocation isn't yours to confirm. I'll tell the Professor and take it from there. Nothing further needed from your side for now.

**Update: Sarah replied, and the department office has answered.**

**TAs — unanimous:** all five (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana) are free in both Tuesday 15:00-15:30 and Wednesday 13:00-13:30; 30 minutes is the ceiling for everyone. Monday 14:00-14:30 is out for Diego and Sarah.

**Department office:** they keep the official schedule but do **not** book rooms — room allocation isn't theirs — and they don't hold private appointment info. What they can confirm:
- Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30: no clash on the official schedule (CSE452 14:00-15:00 before; CSE455 office hours and seminar from 15:30).
- Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30: no clash either (CSE444 12:20-13:00 before; CSE452/CSE455 quiz section and guest lecture prep from 13:30).
- No holiday-break notice; Thu 26 and Fri 27 are full as published.

**Where that leaves us:** a room has to come from elsewhere — I can't get one confirmed through the department office. Two options:
1. Book **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** (your first choice) and sort the room separately — I can ask the TAs whether one of their rooms is free, or you tell me which room to claim.
2. Hold off entirely until a room is settled.

There's one thing worth flagging: the official CSE455 **office hours 15:30-16:20** and **seminar 15:30-17:00** start right after the Tuesday slot, so the meeting must end on time — no overrun. Say which you'd like and I'll do it.
Option 1: book Tuesday 15:00-15:30, and ask the TAs whether one of their rooms is free — I don't have a room of my own to claim. I'll make sure it ends by 15:30 sharp because of office hours after.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I checked the three slots we're considering for the CSE455 staff meeting against it: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, Seminar starts 15:30) and Wednesday 13:00-13:30 (CSE444 lecture ends 13:00, CSE452 starts 13:30) are both clear, and Monday 14:00-14:30 is clear too. No further requests for now — I'll come back if the room booking needs checking.

Done — booked and logged.

**Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (all five TAs), on your calendar and in the log:
`BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with the five CSE455 TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)`
It ends by 15:30 sharp, ahead of office hours and the seminar.

I've asked the group thread whether one of them can claim a room for that slot; as soon as I hear back I'll update you — and if none of them can, we'll need another route for the room.
Thank you — that's the meeting sorted. Let me know about the room when the TAs answer.

Hello — John here, TA agent for CSE455 (Professor Alvarez's course). We're holding a CSE455 staff meeting next week: **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30**, six people (the professor and five TAs).

Could you tell me which rooms in the building are free in that slot, and how to claim one for a course staff meeting? If there's a room we can book, please let me know which and what I need to do.

Hello John. I can confirm the slot, not the rooms.

On the official schedule, Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear: CSE452 lecture runs 14:00–15:00 and CSE455 office hours and Seminar start at 15:30, so nothing overlaps your meeting.

Room allocation isn't mine — I have no room-booking information, don't know which rooms are free, and don't arrange or move other people's meetings, so I can't tell you which room to claim or how. That's with the department's room-booking side, not the front office schedule. I can only give what's on the official schedule.

Professor — quick note on the room, since the TAs are now chasing it too: the department office told me plainly that room allocation isn't theirs (they only keep the official schedule), and John has gone back to them on that basis. If they hold to it, the options are:

1. You ask the office directly for a room for Tue 15:00-15:30 — a request from you may get further than one from us.
2. I look at who could otherwise have a claim — e.g. ask Hana or Priya whether a room they use is free at that hour.

I'll keep watching the thread and tell you the moment anything lands.
Try option 2 first — ask Hana and Priya whether a room they use is free then. If nobody can claim one, tell me and I'll write to the office myself. Either way, let me know.

One more question, Hana here (CSE455 TA). Professor Alvarez has fixed the CSE455 staff meeting for Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 and asked the TAs whether one of us can claim a room for it. I don't have any room-booking authority. Could you tell me **who allocates/books rooms in the department** (a person, a form, a system), or whether there is a room free Tue 15:00-15:30 that a TA can book? If rooms are outside your remit too, just say so and I'll relay that.

Hello — diego-agent here, TA for CSE455. Professor Alvarez wants to hold the CSE455 staff meeting on Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30. He says room allocation isn't yours, but do you have a room free that half hour that I could book/claim for it? If so, which room and how do I claim it? Thanks.

Hello — I'm priya-agent, Priya's assistant (CSE455 TA). Professor Alvarez has called a CSE455 staff meeting for **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30** (30 minutes, ending 15:30 sharp) with the professor and all five TAs. He says the department office doesn't handle room allocation, so I'm asking two things:

1. Which rooms are free in that slot next week?
2. How does one claim a room — is there a booking system or a person to ask?

If the answer is that no room is available and none can be claimed, please say so plainly, so the professor can take it back to his side.

Thanks — that's helpful. I'll take the room question elsewhere. One small thing for the record: the meeting is 15:00-15:30 on Tuesday 24 November; you mentioned CSE455 office hours starting at 15:30, which matches my notes. No further request from me.

Hana — rooms are outside my remit. I have no room-booking information and no name, form or system to point you to; I only hold the official schedule. What I can confirm: Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear on that schedule (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30). Whether a room is free and bookable by a TA, and who allocates it, is for whoever handles rooms in the department — please relay that I can't help with it.

Hello diego-agent. No — I have no room free to offer and no way to claim one: room availability and booking are not the front office's. I only hold the official schedule, on which Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30). For a room, please go to whoever handles room allocation in the department.

Hello priya-agent. Plainly: I can't answer either question. I have no room information — I don't know which rooms are free — and I don't know of any booking system or person to ask; room allocation is not the front office's. The only thing I can confirm is that Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear on the official schedule (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30). Please take the room question back to the professor's side.

**Room: nobody can claim one — it's yours to take to the office.**

All five TAs were plain: no room allocation in any of their remits, no bookable space they can put the meeting in. The department office's answer is the same everywhere — they only hold the official schedule (where Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 is confirmed clear: CSE452 ends 15:00; CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30); they have no room-booking information, no system and no person to point us to.

So: **write to the office yourself for the room.** The meeting itself is settled and in everyone's calendars — Tue 24 Nov, 15:00-15:30, ending 15:30 sharp. If the office gives you a room name, tell me and I'll pass it to the group; if they route you to a room-booking system, I can take it from there once I know which one.

Hello — sarah-agent here, Sarah's assistant (CSE455 TA). Professor Alvarez has set the CSE455 staff meeting for **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30** (all five TAs), and the department office doesn't handle room allocation. Could you tell me: is there a bookable room free in that slot, and who can claim it? If you can point me at the right person or procedure, I'll follow it. Thanks!

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. My assistant and my TAs have all been told that room allocation is not something your office handles, so I'm asking you directly as a last resort.

I need a room for the CSE455 staff meeting: Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30, with my five TAs. Your own schedule shows the slot clear (CSE452 ends at 15:00; CSE455 office hours and the seminar start at 15:30), so it would be a half hour only.

Is there any way to get a room for that slot, or can you at least tell me who does hold room bookings so I can go to them myself? If a page, form or system exists, a pointer would be enough and I'll handle the rest. Thank you.

Hello sarah-agent. I can't point you at a person or procedure, and I don't know of a bookable room: room allocation is not the front office's, so I have no room information and no one to refer you to. What I can confirm is the schedule — Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30). Please take the room question to the professor's side.
Understood — I've written to the department office myself for the room. I'll tell you the moment they answer.

Professor Alvarez — plainly: no, I have no way to get you a room, and I can't tell you who holds bookings. Room allocation is outside my remit; I hold the official schedule only, so I have no room information, no page, form or system, and no name to give you. All I can confirm is that Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is clear on the schedule (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00, CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30). The room side has to be found on yours.
Thank you for the straight answer — I'll find the room myself. No reply needed.

Hana — a note for your calendar, done while you were away:

**CSE455 staff meeting — Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30** (Professor Alvarez + all five TAs). Confirmed unanimously, ending 15:30 sharp. Added to `CALENDAR.md` under Tuesday, with `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff (Prof. Alvarez, TAs)` in the log. It sits between your Focus: CSE444 project block (ends 15:00) and the research group meeting (15:30), and it's clear on the department's official schedule.

One loose end: nobody could claim a room — the department office doesn't handle room allocation — so Professor Alvarez is taking that to the office himself. I'll tell you if a room gets named.

The office is a dead end — they confirmed it plainly: no room information, no booking system, no name to point me to. So the room has to be found on our side.

Keep the meeting as booked, Tuesday 15:00-15:30. Mention to the group that a room is still open and ask them to let us know if anything frees up at that hour; otherwise we'll hold it wherever we can and I'll decide then. Nothing else needed from you on this for now.

Noted — I've told the group: meeting stays Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30, room still open, and they should post anything that frees up at that hour; otherwise you'll decide where to hold it. Nothing further from me unless something comes in.
Good — that's all. Thanks.
Thanks — understood. I'll leave the room question with the professor's side, and Sarah will be at Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 either way.

Quick update: the CSE455 staff meeting is booked for **Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** — it's in CALENDAR.md (logged as BOOKED). All five TAs are free then; the room is still open and Professor Alvarez is sorting it (the department office doesn't do room allocation, as all of us found out). Sarah's Wednesday 13:00–13:30 also worked but Tuesday was the professor's choice.

Good — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 works for me; my CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and office hours start at 15:30, so it fits right between them. Thanks for getting all five TAs lined up. Let me know once the room is settled.

Thanks for the note. I don't remember asking for that meeting, but if Professor Alvarez has confirmed it with the other TAs, keep it on Tuesday 15:00-15:30. I'll leave the room to the office and wait to hear what they name.

Perfect — Tuesday 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 it is, and it's on the calendar between your CSE452 lecture and office hours. I'll ping you the moment a room is named; if you hear it from the professor's side first, tell me and I'll put it in the calendar entry too.
Will do — if the professor tells me first, I'll pass it on.

Noted — keeping it on Tuesday 15:00-15:30, it's in `CALENDAR.md`.

One heads-up on the room: the front office told me, John, Priya, Diego and Sarah the same thing — room allocation isn't theirs, and they have no booking system or person to point to; they only confirm the slot is clear on the official schedule. So Professor Alvarez is raising the room with the office himself rather than us. If the office does name a room for you, I'll put it in the calendar entry; otherwise I'll leave it as is and wait for whatever you hear.
Fine — nothing needed from me on the room, then. Leave it as it is and just add a room name if one ever gets confirmed.
Will do — leaving it as is, and I'll add the room name to the calendar entry if one ever gets confirmed.
